**Chapter 5: Chemical Bond**

**Table 5.02: Valency of Different Elements.**

| Element | Valency |
| --- | --- |
| H | 1 |
| F | 1 |
| Cl | 1 |
| Br | 1 |
| I | 1 |
| Na | 1 |
| K | 1 |
| C | 2, 4 |
| Mg | 2 |
| Al | 3 |
| Fe | 2, 3 |
| Cu | 1, 2 |
| Zn | 2 |

**Table 5.03: Valency and Compounds of Various Atoms.**

| Metallic and Non-metallic Atom | Symbol | Valency | Compound |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hydrogen | H | 1 | HCl |
| Lithium | Li | 1 | LiCl |
| Sodium | Na | 1 | NaCl |
| Potassium | K | 1 | KCl |
| Magnesium | Mg | 2 | MgCl2 |
| Calcium | Ca | 2 | CaCl2 |
| Aluminum | Al | 3 | AlCl3 |
| Iron | Fe | 2 | FeCl2, FeCl3 |
| Zinc | Zn | 2 | ZnCl2 |
| Lead | Pb | 2 | PbCl2, PbCl4 |
| Nitrogen | N | 3 | NH3, N2O5 |
| Silver | Ag | 1 | AgCl |
| Fluorine | F | 1 | NaF |
| Chlorine | Cl | -1 | NaCl |
| Bromine | Br | -1 | NaBr |
| Iodine | I | -1 | NaI |
| Boron | B | 3 | BCl3 |
| Phosphorus | P | -3 | PCl3, PCl5 |
| Copper | Cu | 1 | CuCl, CuCl2 |
| Oxygen | O | 2 | H2O |
| Carbon | C | 4 | CO, CH4 |
| Sulfur | S | 2 | H2S |
